title: zeravschania minjanensis
intro: Zeravschania minjanensis, commonly known as the Zeravschania plant, is a type of flowering plant in the lily family (Liliaceae). The health benefits of Zeravschania minjanensis include its potential use in treating various conditions such as inflammation, fever, and respiratory issues. Its therapeutic actions include anti-inflammatory, antipyretic, and expectorant properties, which can help alleviate symptoms associated with these conditions. The bioactive constituents of Zeravschania minjanensis include flavonoids, alkaloids, and glycosides, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
